parsed.answer: Early reports (Chui 1999) treated BET surface area of MOFs as an intrinsic material property. By 2007 Walton & Snurr showed BET’s assumptions are stretched for microporous frameworks but can still be applied if the pressure range is chosen carefully, hinting that BET area is not strictly intrinsic. Thus, the consensus evolved from an intrinsic view to one that recognizes BET area as strongly dependent on activation and fitting protocols.
